title: lupinus lepidus var. ashlandensis
intro: Lupinus lepidus var. ashlandensis, commonly known as Ashland Lupine, is a perennial plant species in the family Fabaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and vasodilatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Ashland Lupine are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce stress, and promote better sleep. The bioactive constituents of Ashland Lupine include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
